title: Mid-level Python backend engineer
description: A 4-year Python/FastAPI/PostgreSQL backend engineer evaluated against 8 postings: one strong match with clear gaps, one semantic match with zero keyword overlap, one keyword-stuffed trap, one marginal data role, and four distractors.
rationale: j2 expresses a genuinely good backend fit using deliberately generic vocabulary ('modern dynamic server-side language', 'relational data modeling') that shares almost no tokens with the resume — TF-IDF cannot see it, embeddings should. j3 is a technical-recruiting role whose posting is stuffed with the resume's exact stack keywords (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker) — TF-IDF over-ranks it, the hybrid matcher should not. j4 (data engineering) probes the graded boundary: real Python/SQL overlap but the core stack (Spark/Airflow/dbt) is absent. Gap target j1 has unambiguous annotated gaps (Kubernetes/AWS required, Terraform/GraphQL preferred) and abundant must_not_claim skills the resume clearly holds.

jobs.raw_text:
Senior Backend Engineer — Nimbus Health (Remote, US)

Nimbus Health builds scheduling infrastructure for outpatient clinics. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own core API services.

What you will do:
- Design and evolve REST APIs for our patient scheduling platform
- Own PostgreSQL schema design, migrations, and query performance
- Operate services deployed on Kubernetes in AWS
- Mentor two junior engineers through code review and pairing

Requirements: Python, FastAPI or Flask, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, AWS. 5+ years building production backend services, 2+ years operating workloads on Kubernetes. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have: Terraform, GraphQL, HIPAA compliance experience.

Server-Side Engineer — Loopwire (Hybrid, Denver CO)

Loopwire's customer portal is growing fast and the service layer behind it needs an owner. We care about fundamentals, not brand names — our stack is boring on purpose and we are language-agnostic for the right person.

You will build and maintain the service layer behind our customer-facing web product, model business data in a relational database, keep query performance healthy, and collaborate with frontend engineers on API contracts.

We look for: fluency in a modern dynamic server-side language, solid relational data modeling, thoughtful HTTP API design, and strong automated testing habits. 3+ years shipping server-side software. Bonus: familiarity with message queues and containerized deployments.
